heading: EXT. AUTO SALVAGE YARD - CAR CRUSHER BAY - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. AUTO SALVAGE YARD - CAR CRUSHER BAY - NIGHT
Towers of flattened cars.
A hydraulic crusher squats at the end of a gravel lane, its steel jaws open like a mouth.
A sodium lamp buzzes on a pole.
A MAN in a dark jacket, 40s, slams the trunk of a black sedan shut.
He wipes his hands on his pants.
From the passenger side, a WOMAN in a leather coat, 30s, hurries around the car, hugging herself.
At the office window, a KID, 17, in a hoodie, watches from behind a curtain.
The man opens the sedan's back door.
A heavy gym bag sits on the seat.
Did you check the plates?
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: Twice.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Did you check the plates again?
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: Nina. They're clean.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Don't say my name.
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: Who's going to hear?
units.name: MAN

units.text: She nods toward the office.
The Kid has vanished from the window.
That's Terrence's nephew. He doesn't count.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Everyone counts.
units.name: NINA

units.text: The man hauls out the gym bag.
It lands on the gravel with a clink.
The office door opens.
The Kid steps out, hands in pockets, walking slow.
You guys need the crusher?
units.name: KID

units.text: Yeah. For the sedan.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Papers?
units.name: KID

units.text: No papers.
units.name: NINA

units.text: No papers, no crusher. That's Terrence's rule.
units.name: KID

units.text: Terrence is a friend.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Terrence is in Phoenix.
units.name: KID

units.text: The man smiles, shows teeth.
He steps closer.
The Kid doesn't step back.
Kid. What's your name?
units.name: MAN

units.text: Eli.
units.name: KID

units.text: Eli. Listen to me. A man left this car here. It's got to go.
units.name: MAN

units.text: Then he can come back and fill out a form.
units.name: ELI

units.text: Eli, we're running behind.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Then you should've been on time.
units.name: ELI

units.text: The man lunges, grabs Eli by the hoodie.
Eli drops his phone, kicks the man's shin, and twists free.
The man staggers into the sedan's open door.
Nina grabs the gym bag and swings it into the man's back.
All three go down in the gravel, tangled.
Eli scrambles to the crusher's control panel.
Slaps a lever.
The jaws groan and begin to close.
Eli! Don't!
units.name: NINA

units.text: You said no papers!
units.name: ELI

units.text: The man rolls away.
The jaws descend on the sedan with a scream of metal.
The gym bag, caught half under the door, is dragged in.
Nina stares, mouth open.
The man gets up slowly, face bleeding.
You have any idea what was in that bag?
units.name: MAN

units.text: Terrence's rules.
units.name: ELI

units.text: The crusher bottoms out.
Glass bursts.
A cloud of dust and loose banknotes swirls up through the sodium light, drifting down like snow.
